lyrics:
[Intro: brass riff, organ stab, clean house kick]

[Verse 1: gritty female soul voice]
You got the watch, you got the boat shoes on
You got the speaker playing your own song
You got a table and a bucket and a crew
Honey, none of that is working on you

[Chorus: brass riff answers, full groove]
I got big hat energy
Shade wherever I go
Wide brim, slow walk, lemonade
I don't need to see your boat
Big hat energy
Sit down, you're blocking my sun

[Drop: brass riff and organ, handclaps]

[Verse 2: voice sharper, bass walking]
I've been fifty, I've been broke
I've been somebody's little joke
Now I take up all the room I please
Chair for my bag and a chair for my knees

[Chorus: brass riff answers, full groove]
I got big hat energy
Shade wherever I go
Wide brim, slow walk, lemonade
I don't need to see your boat
Big hat energy
Sit down, you're blocking my sun

[Break: kick and bass only, spoken]
Mm-hm. That's better.

[Final Chorus: full band, brass doubled]
I got big hat energy
Shade wherever I go
Wide brim, slow walk, lemonade
I don't need to see your boat
Big hat energy
Sit down, you're blocking my sun

[Outro: brass riff, a straw in an empty glass]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 122 BPM, 4/4, A minor. A strutting funk-house groove with a 1960s soul heart.

VOICE: Female, a big, gritty, slightly overdriven soul voice in the manner of a vintage 45, full of attitude and humour. She sings just behind the beat. One dry spoken line in the break.

INSTRUMENTS: A punchy three-piece brass riff (trumpet, tenor sax, trombone), Hammond organ stabs, a clean four-on-the-floor kick with an open hi-hat on the off-beat, a walking electric bass, a scratchy rhythm guitar, handclaps, tambourine.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, brass riff and kick. 0:10 Verse 1. 0:34 Chorus 1. 0:58 Drop, brass and organ. 1:14 Verse 2. 1:38 Chorus 2. 2:02 Break, kick and bass. 2:12 Final chorus. 2:38 Outro, brass riff and a straw, ends 2:56.

PRODUCTION & MIX: Vintage soul recording on a modern house beat: the voice and brass warm and a little dirty, the drums clean and tight.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: 'Sit down, you're blocking my sun' at 0:54.

STATION FIT: 3 p.m., the busiest hour on the deck. Up-tempo and brassy, the track that gets heads nodding without turning the place into a club.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Unimpressed, amused, proud, comfortable.
